# Breathe Quality

> Breathe Quality is a comprehensive indoor air quality guide offering expert reviews, rankings, and buying guides for air purifiers across various needs and room sizes.

The site provides detailed comparisons of air purifier models from leading brands like Honeywell, Rabbit Air, and IQAir, with specialized guides for different use cases including allergies, pets, smoke, and mold. All content follows strict editorial standards to ensure unbiased, trustworthy recommendations for improving home air quality.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filters
- CADR rating
- ACH (Air Changes per Hour)
- Indoor air quality
- Honeywell air purifiers
- Allergy relief
- Air purifier buying guide
- Product comparison
- Energy Star certification
- Smoke and odor removal
- Pet dander removal
- Mold and mildew filtration
- Bedroom air purifiers
- Large room coverage
- Air purifier brands
